snippet.title: Blunderworld - Now On Steam!
snippet.description: Blunderworld is a numbers-go-up roguelike where you shoot a disc to rack up massive multipliers! Collect upgrades, defeat the Lords of Sin, and unlock challenges to conquer the underworld! Coming in October. Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3944070/Blunderworld/
